name: Fonts In Use · Footnotes, issue F

title.zh: Fonts In Use · 从真实作品对照字体与版式
title.en: Fonts In Use · Footnotes, issue F

description.zh: 对照期刊封面与右侧字体，继续阅读作品说明。 记录真实作品中字体应用的独立档案，按题材、载体和字体组织案例。集合页并列作品图片与字体字样，单篇补充作品说明和署名；网站条款限定个人非商业访问，网站内容商业再利用需书面同意，照片及底层字体许可另核。
description.en: An independent archive of typography in real projects, organized by topic, format, and typeface. Collection pages pair work images with typeface specimens; individual entries add project descriptions and credits. The site terms grant personal, noncommercial access and require written consent for commercial reuse of site content; photographs and underlying fonts require their own license checks.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Fonts In Use (https://fontsinuse.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 对照期刊封面与右侧字体，继续阅读作品说明。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在 Art 首排对照灰底作品标签、白蓝书页和展墙标题，注意同一字号感受如何随载体改变，再开 Footnotes 的期刊封面。建议把右侧字体字样与作品位置一起看，继续下滚读说明；当前封面只显示局部，内页须另看。我们将它作为排版案例档案，网站条款限定个人非商业访问，内容商业再利用需书面同意，照片和字体也须各自核对许可。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
